heading_en: Prohibition on the Use of Unsolicited Ratings
summary_ja: リスク・ウェイトの判定に非依頼格付を使用することを禁止する（中央政府に付与されたものを除く）。
summary_en: Prohibits the use of unsolicited ratings in determining risk weights, except ratings assigned to central governments.
paragraphs: In determining risk weights, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall not use unsolicited ratings; provided, however, that this shall not apply where the rating has been assigned to a central government.
